summary.headline: Calends, Brontologia, and Selenodromion
summary.text: Description of a 13th-century, 158-folio codex with calends omens, two brontologia, astronomical and lunar computations for illness, death, temperament, harvests, and vintages, plus a fragmentary selenodromion. The selenodromion records lunar-day prognostics, including the births of Noah and Samuel, and is compared with codex 20 of the Antinori Florentine collection and a complete version to be edited from codex 16.
